using System;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Net.Http.Headers;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Moq;
using OpenRA.Mods.Common;
using Xunit;

namespace OpenRA.Mods.Common.Tests
{
    public class ItchIntegrationTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task GetPlayerName_WithNoApiKey_DoesNotInvokeCallback()
        {
            // Arrange
            var callback = new Mock<Action<string>>();
            Environment.SetEnvironmentVariable("ITCHIO_API_KEY", null);
            var integration = new ItchIntegration();

            // Act
            integration.GetPlayerName(callback.Object);

            // Assert
            await Task.Delay(100); // Allow async task to complete
            callback.Verify(c => c(It.IsAny<string>()), Times.Never);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task GetPlayerName_WithApiKeyAndSuccessfulResponse_InvokesCallbackWithDisplayName()
        {
            // Arrange
            var fakeApiKey = "fake-key";
            var fakeJson = "{\"user\":{\"display_name\":\"TestDisplay\",\"username\":\"testuser\"}}";
            var fakeContent = new StringContent(fakeJson, Encoding.UTF8, "application/json");
            var fakeResponse = new HttpResponseMessage(System.Net.HttpStatusCode.OK) { Content = fakeContent };
            var mockHttpClient = new Mock<HttpClient>();
            mockHttpClient.Setup(c => c.GetAsync("https://itch.io/api/1/jwt/me")).ReturnsAsync(fakeResponse);

            // Replace HttpClientFactory.Create with our mock (integration test approach)
            var httpClientField = typeof(HttpClientFactory).GetField("client", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Static);
            httpClientField?.SetValue(null, mockHttpClient.Object);

            Environment.SetEnvironmentVariable("ITCHIO_API_KEY", fakeApiKey);
            var callback = new Mock<Action<string>>();
            var integration = new ItchIntegration();

            // Act
            integration.GetPlayerName(callback.Object);

            // Assert
            await Task.Delay(100);
            callback.Verify(c => c("TestDisplay"), Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task GetPlayerName_WithApiKeyAndNoDisplayName_InvokesCallbackWithUsername()
        {
            // Arrange
            var fakeApiKey = "fake-key";
            var fakeJson = "{\"user\":{\"username\":\"testuser\"}}";
            var fakeContent = new StringContent(fakeJson, Encoding.UTF8, "application/json");
            var fakeResponse = new HttpResponseMessage(System.Net.HttpStatusCode.OK) { Content = fakeContent };
            var mockHttpClient = new Mock<HttpClient>();
            mockHttpClient.Setup(c => c.GetAsync("https://itch.io/api/1/jwt/me")).ReturnsAsync(fakeResponse);

            var httpClientField = typeof(HttpClientFactory).GetField("client", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Static);
            httpClientField?.SetValue(null, mockHttpClient.Object);

            Environment.SetEnvironmentVariable("ITCHIO_API_KEY", fakeApiKey);
            var callback = new Mock<Action<string>>();
            var integration = new ItchIntegration();

            // Act
            integration.GetPlayerName(callback.Object);

            // Assert
            await Task.Delay(100);
            callback.Verify(c => c("testuser"), Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task GetPlayerName_WithApiKeyAndHttpError_DoesNotInvokeCallback()
        {
            // Arrange
            var fakeApiKey = "fake-key";
            var fakeResponse = new HttpResponseMessage(System.Net.HttpStatusCode.BadRequest);
            var mockHttpClient = new Mock<HttpClient>();
            mockHttpClient.Setup(c => c.GetAsync("https://itch.io/api/1/jwt/me")).ReturnsAsync(fakeResponse);

            var httpClientField = typeof(HttpClientFactory).GetField("client", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Static);
            httpClientField?.SetValue(null, mockHttpClient.Object);

            Environment.SetEnvironmentVariable("ITCHIO_API_KEY", fakeApiKey);
            var callback = new Mock<Action<string>>();
            var integration = new ItchIntegration();

            // Act
            integration.GetPlayerName(callback.Object);

            // Assert
            await Task.Delay(100);
            callback.Verify(c => c(It.IsAny<string>()), Times.Never);
        }
    }
}

using System;

    {
        private readonly Mock<HttpMessageHandler> _mockHandler;
        private readonly HttpClient _mockHttpClient;
        private readonly ItchIntegration _integration;
        private readonly Mock<Action<string>> _mockCallback;

        public ItchIntegrationTests()
        {
            _mockHandler = new Mock<HttpMessageHandler>();
            _mockHttpClient = new HttpClient(_mockHandler.Object);
            
            // Mock HttpClientFactory.Create() via reflection - try common locations
            MockHttpClientFactory();

            _integration = new ItchIntegration();
            _mockCallback = new Mock<Action<string>>();
        }

        private void MockHttpClientFactory()
        {
            try
            {
                // Try OpenRA.Core first
                var type = Type.GetType("OpenRA.Core.HttpClientFactory, OpenRA.Core");
                if (type != null)
                {
                    var field = type.GetField("client", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Static);
                    field?.SetValue(null, _mockHttpClient);
                    return;
                }
            }
            catch { }

            try
            {
                // Fallback to any assembly with HttpClientFactory
                var types = AppDomain.CurrentDomain.GetAssemblies()
                    .SelectMany(a => a.GetTypes())
                    .Where(t => t.Name == "HttpClientFactory")
                    .ToArray();
                
                if (types.Length > 0)
                {
                    var field = types[0].GetField("client", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Static);
                    field?.SetValue(null, _mockHttpClient);
                }
            }
            catch { }
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task GetPlayerName_NoApiKey_DoesNotInvokeCallback()

            // Act

using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Net.Http.Headers;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Moq;
using OpenRA.Mods.Common;
using OpenRA.Support;
using Xunit;

namespace OpenRA.Mods.Common.Tests
{
    public class ItchIntegrationTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task GetPlayerName_NoApiKey_DoesNotInvokeCallback()
        {
            // Arrange
            var callbackFired = false;
            Action<string> callback = name => callbackFired = true;
            Environment.SetEnvironmentVariable("ITCHIO_API_KEY", null);
            var integration = new ItchIntegration();

            // Act
            integration.GetPlayerName(callback);
            await Task.Delay(500);

            // Assert
            Assert.False(callbackFired);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task GetPlayerName_ValidApiKeyWithDisplayName_InvokesCallbackWithDisplayName()
        {
            // Arrange
            var receivedName = (string)null;
            Action<string> callback = name => receivedName = name;
            
            // Mock HttpClientFactory by replacing its static instance via reflection
            var mockClient = CreateMockHttpClient("{\"user\":{\"display_name\":\"TestDisplay\",\"username\":\"testuser\"}}");
            
            Environment.SetEnvironmentVariable("ITCHIO_API_KEY", "test-key");
            var integration = new ItchIntegration();

            // Act
            integration.GetPlayerName(callback);
            await Task.Delay(500);

            // Assert
            Assert.Equal("TestDisplay", receivedName);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task GetPlayerName_ValidApiKeyNoDisplayName_InvokesCallbackWithUsername()
        {
            // Arrange
            var receivedName = (string)null;
            Action<string> callback = name => receivedName = name;
            
            var mockClient = CreateMockHttpClient("{\"user\":{\"username\":\"testuser\"}}");
            
            Environment.SetEnvironmentVariable("ITCHIO_API_KEY", "test-key");
            var integration = new ItchIntegration();

            // Act
            integration.GetPlayerName(callback);
            await Task.Delay(500);

            // Assert
            Assert.Equal("testuser", receivedName);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task GetPlayerName_HttpError_DoesNotInvokeCallback()
        {
            // Arrange
            var callbackFired = false;
            Action<string> callback = name => callbackFired = true;
            
            CreateMockHttpClient("", System.Net.HttpStatusCode.BadRequest);
            
            Environment.SetEnvironmentVariable("ITCHIO_API_KEY", "test-key");
            var integration = new ItchIntegration();

            // Act
            integration.GetPlayerName(callback);
            await Task.Delay(500);

            // Assert
            Assert.False(callbackFired);
        }

        private HttpClient CreateMockHttpClient(string jsonResponse, System.Net.HttpStatusCode statusCode = System.Net.HttpStatusCode.OK)
        {
            var handler = new Mock<HttpMessageHandler>();
            handler
                .Setup(h => h.SendAsync(It.IsAny<HttpRequestMessage>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
                .ReturnsAsync(new HttpResponseMessage(statusCode)
                {
                    Content = new StringContent(jsonResponse, Encoding.UTF8, "application/json")
                });

            var mockClient = new HttpClient(handler.Object);
            
            // Replace HttpClientFactory's internal static client via reflection
            var factoryType = Type.GetType("OpenRA.Core.HttpClientFactory, OpenRA.Core") 
                           ?? Type.GetType("OpenRA.Platform.HttpClientFactory, OpenRA.Platform");
            
            if (factoryType != null)
            {
                var field = factoryType.GetField("client", 
                    System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Static);
                field?.SetValue(null, mockClient);
            }
            
            return mockClient;
        }
    }
}
